title: Boundary rectifiability for compactly supported currents in ℝ^P from the deformation theorem and CL(d)
statement: Assume (DT), the exact frozen statement of cmc_deformation_theorem (first hypothesis of the Lean statement). For every P, m there is c ≥ 1 such that for all ρ > 0, compact K and Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, every integer multiplicity T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with spt T ⊆ K, M(T) ≤ Λ and M(∂T) < ∞ decomposes as T − Q − S = ∂R. Here Q, ∂Q, R are integer multiplicity, M(∂Q) ≤ cM(∂T), M(R) ≤ cρM(T) and M(S) ≤ cρM(∂T) (plus further conclusions not used here). Let d ∈ ℕ and assume CL(d), verbatim: for all P, open U ⊆ ℝ^P and integer multiplicity T_j ∈ 𝒟_d(U) with sup_j (M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure in U, and T_j ⇀ T ∈ 𝒟_d(U), T is integer multiplicity. Let P ∈ ℕ, T ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) integer multiplicity, and K ⊆ ℝ^P compact with spt T ⊆ K, M(T) < ∞ and M(∂T) < ∞. Then ∂T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : NNReal, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal), 0 < ρ → IsCompact K → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → T.support ⊆ K → T.mass ≤ Λ → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Q.boundary ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ T - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ (Q = 0 ∨ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Q.mass) ∧ Q.mass ≤ c * T.mass ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ c * T.boundary.mass ∧ R.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.mass ∧ S.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.boundary.mass ∧ Q.support ∪ R.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.support ∧ Q.boundary.support ∪ S.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.boundary.support) → ∀ d : ℕ, (∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → T.support ⊆ K → T.mass < ∞ → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary
